# `aitbc exchange sell_admin status`

Show the sell lane's enabled/disabled state and non-secret config (flags, limits, addresses, key-slot booleans — never key material).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc exchange sell_admin status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--hub-url` | text | — | no | Hub wallet-service base URL — bare origin, path is stripped (default: configured wallet daemon) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc exchange sell_admin status
```
